reading.title: Producing Adaptive Urban Space in Informal Settlements: Evidence from Maputo
reading.why: It examines informal settlements, climate hazards like heat and flooding, and local production of space, echoing the social-ecological focus in the student's context.
questions: How do residents modify housing to handle heat and floods?
What is the role of co-production in infrastructure?
How does the adaptive urban space concept link to spatial domains?
reading.check: You cannot establish whether these socio-spatial practices successfully lower physical flood levels or heat stress.

coverage: Coverage is limited to a few world news items, EU developments, Germany, and one selected paper on Maputo, with no direct coverage of Kabul, Afghanistan.
